tagline: Pioneering packaged coconut water and plant-based beverages globally, with market leadership in coconut water category across North America and Europe.
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin is the key KPI for COCO as it directly reflects the efficiency of managing sourcing and production costs amid significant tariff inflation (23% weighted average rates in Q3 2025) and volatility in maritime freight costs. This KPI is critical to assess the company's ability to preserve profitability under external pressures.

kpis.name: Coconut Water Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue derived from the coconut water category (including branded and Private Label products).
kpis.description: Coconut water represents 96% of revenue in 2025, reflecting the strategic dominance of this category for COCO and the critical importance of its stability.
kpis.signal: Indicates product portfolio concentration and category dependency.

kpis.name: US Coconut Water Market Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of market share held by Vita Coco in the coconut water category in the United States.
kpis.description: Vita Coco maintains a market share of over 40% in the coconut water category in the United States, demonstrating its industry leadership position.
kpis.signal: Indicator of competitive positioning and brand strength in the primary market.

kpis.name: UK Coconut Water Market Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of market share held by Vita Coco in the coconut water category in the United Kingdom.
kpis.description: Vita Coco holds a market share of over 80% in the coconut water category in the United Kingdom, reflecting a near-monopoly position in this market.
kpis.signal: Indicator of dominant competitive positioning in a key secondary market.

kpis.name: Customer Concentration (Top 2)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of consolidated revenue generated from the two largest customers.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, sales to the two largest customers represented 44% of consolidated net revenue, creating a significant concentration risk.
kpis.signal: Indicator of credit risk and customer dependency.

kpis.name: Tariff Cost Incurred in 2025
kpis.explanation: Total amount of customs tariffs paid on imports in 2025.
kpis.description: The company paid $16 million in customs tariffs in 2025, with an estimated weighted average rate of 23% in Q3 prior to the November 2025 relief.
kpis.signal: Measures the direct impact of trade policies on operational costs.

kpis.name: Number of Supply Factories
kpis.explanation: Number of factories in the global supply network for sourcing coconut water.
kpis.description: COCO sources coconut water from a diversified global network of approximately 16 factories across 6 countries, supporting a fixed-asset-light supply model.
kpis.signal: Indicator of supply chain diversification and flexibility.

kpis.name: Number of Distribution Countries
kpis.explanation: Number of countries where the Vita Coco brand is available.
kpis.description: Vita Coco is available in over 35 countries, with primary markets in North America, the United Kingdom, and Germany.
kpis.signal: Indicator of geographic reach and international growth potential.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Risk
risks.summary: High reliance on two major customers exposes the company to significant credit risk if these customers face financial difficulties.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 1A, the risk is significant as 44% of sales come from two major customers. Although no credit issues have occurred, the concentration is high and could lead to substantial losses in case of default. The Credit category is weighted. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Impact of US Trade Policies and Tariff Pressures
risks.summary: Changes in US trade policies, such as imposition of customs tariffs (up to 50% for Brazil, 20% for Asia), increased costs by $16 million in 2025 and created uncertainty despite November relief measures.
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A explicitly states that changes in US trade policy, including customs tariffs, increased costs ($16M in 2025) and created significant uncertainty. The language is direct and indicates a material impact on operations. Severity is high as tariff pressures reached a 23% weighted average rate. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk Related to Trade Promotion Accruals
risks.summary: Estimating customer rebates and trade promotions is complex and subjective, posing a risk of errors that could affect reported revenues and earnings.
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a 'critical audit matter' by auditors, this risk involves estimating customer rebates and trade promotions, which require subjective judgment. Errors in these estimates could have a material impact on financial statements. The Operational category is appropriate as it relates to estimation processes. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of Economic Disruptions and Demand Slowdown
risks.summary: A broad economic slowdown could reduce demand for coconut water beverages and result in significant additional costs for the company.
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates that major economic disruptions or a general economic slowdown could lead to substantial additional charges and reduced demand for products. This risk is inherently macroeconomic and directly affects consumption of premium beverages. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk Related to Derivatives and Foreign Exchange Volatility
risks.summary: Fluctuations in exchange rates and the value of derivative instruments used for hedging may result in gains or losses affecting profitability, particularly due to international sourcing.
risks.score_rationale: Financial statements show significant variations in the value of derivative instruments used to hedge foreign exchange risk. While the company manages these risks, financial market and currency volatility can affect its results. The Capital category is relevant as it pertains to financial instruments. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of Maritime Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.summary: Geopolitical disruptions affecting maritime routes (Aden Strait, port congestion) create volatility in freight costs and supply lead times, impacting operating margins.
risks.score_rationale: COCO has experienced significant increases in maritime freight costs and supply disruptions (Aden Strait crises in 2024, port congestion). These factors are noted as having materially impacted financial results and could continue to affect margins. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: The company COCO does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The company operates in the functional beverage sector and has no identifiable AI positioning.
